dialogues.jp: ４月７日。
dialogues.en: April 7th.
dialogues.text: April 7th.

dialogues.jp:
窓の外を眺めながら、ついに迎えてしまった日
付を確認した。
dialogues.en: I checked the date again as I looked out the window.
dialogues.text: I checked the date again as I looked out the window.

dialogues.jp: 「入学式か」
dialogues.en: "The first day of school."
dialogues.text: "The first day of school."

dialogues.jp: ベッドから離れて軽く背伸びする。
dialogues.en: I walked away from my bed and stretched.
dialogues.text: I walked away from my bed and stretched.

dialogues.jp:
体調はあまり良くない。なんとなく微熱がある
ような感じだ。
dialogues.en: I don't feel well. I feel like I have a slight fever.
dialogues.text: I don't feel well. I feel like I have a slight fever.

dialogues.jp: もう１度窓の外を眺めて、音夢の部屋に向かう。
dialogues.en: I looked out the window once again, and went to Nemu's room.
dialogues.text: I looked out the window once again, and went to Nemu's room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「けほっ……こほん……」
dialogues.en: "Cough...... cough......"
dialogues.text: "Cough...... cough......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「っ……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Niisan......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan......"

dialogues.jp:
上半身を起こして、音夢がぼーっとした顔で俺
を見上げる。
dialogues.en: She sat up on the bed and looked at me, spaced out.
dialogues.text: She sat up on the bed and looked at me, spaced out.

dialogues.jp: 「風邪か？」
dialogues.en: "A cold?"
dialogues.text: "A cold?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う……うん。ごめん兄さん、ちょっと起きら
　れそうにない」
dialogues.en: "I guess...... Sorry, niisan, I can't get up."
dialogues.text: "I guess...... Sorry, niisan, I can't get up."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく。
dialogues.en: It made me feel......
dialogues.text: It made me feel......

dialogues.jp:
｛ひきょう／卑怯｝なことに、音夢の進学の話を切り出さずに
済むのかと安堵してしまう。
dialogues.en:
I felt relieved, because I thought maybe I didn't have to
tell her that she can't go back to school anymore.
dialogues.text:
I felt relieved, because I thought maybe I didn't have to
tell her that she can't go back to school anymore.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、今日は入学式だけだから、無理して出
　なくてもいいって」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's only the first day of school, so you don't have
to go."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's only the first day of school, so you don't have
to go."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。でも、こういうのは一生に一度しかな
　いからもったいないよね」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. But the first day of high school only happens only
once in a lifetime, and I'm going to miss that."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. But the first day of high school only happens only
once in a lifetime, and I'm going to miss that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁな」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだ、全然関係ないんだけどさ、私が
　どうして風紀委員をやってるか話したっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, have I ever told you why I'm involved with the
school committee?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, have I ever told you why I'm involved with the
school committee?"

dialogues.jp: 唐突に、音夢が手を合わせて微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu put her hands together and smiled.
dialogues.text: Nemu put her hands together and smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「いや」
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ……知りたい？」
dialogues.en: "Teehee...... Do you want to know?"
dialogues.text: "Teehee...... Do you want to know?"

dialogues.jp: ――話してもいい？
dialogues.en: ---- Can I tell you?
dialogues.text: ---- Can I tell you?

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。あのね、私はお祭りが大好きなんだよ。
　兄さんや杉並くんよりも好きだと思う」
dialogues.en:
"I love festivals and parties. I think I like them more than
you or Suginami."
dialogues.text:
"I love festivals and parties. I think I like them more than
you or Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「みんなが楽しそうに笑っていて、幸せそうで、
　仲良くしている姿がすごく好きなの」
dialogues.en: "I love to see everyone so happy and smiling."
dialogues.text: "I love to see everyone so happy and smiling."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だからね。そういう何気ない笑顔をこっそり
　と守れる仕事がしたかったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I wanted to join the school committee, so that I
can plan them and make sure everybody has a good time."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I wanted to join the school committee, so that I
can plan them and make sure everybody has a good time."

dialogues.jp:
まるで子供を見守る母親のように、音夢が嬉し
そうに笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled like a mother who's looking at her child.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled like a mother who's looking at her child.

dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: なんだか涙腺がおかしい。
dialogues.en: My tear duct's acting weird.
dialogues.text: My tear duct's acting weird.

dialogues.jp: 目の奥がジンジンと熱をもってきてしまう。
dialogues.en: The back of my eyes are heating up and aching.
dialogues.text: The back of my eyes are heating up and aching.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だからね……だから」
dialogues.en: "So...... that's why."
dialogues.text: "So...... that's why."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「今日は私のこと忘れて、いっぱい楽しんでき
　てね兄さん」
dialogues.en: "I want you to have fun and don't worry about me. Okay?"
dialogues.text: "I want you to have fun and don't worry about me. Okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……その」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... well."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... well."

dialogues.jp:
なんと言うのか、似合わないくらいうろたえて
しまう。
dialogues.en: I couldn't remain calm.
dialogues.text: I couldn't remain calm.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Niisan......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan......"

dialogues.jp:
そっ、と音夢の手が伸びてきて、俺の頬をなで
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu soothed my cheek with her hand.
dialogues.text: Nemu soothed my cheek with her hand.

dialogues.jp: 完全な不意打ちだった。
dialogues.en:
"Niisan...... don't look like that. Today's a new
beginning."
dialogues.text:
"Niisan...... don't look like that. Today's a new
beginning."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……そんな顔しないで。今日は始まり
　なんだよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Now, go on."
dialogues.text: "Now, go on."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... I'll see you later."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... I'll see you later."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の触れた部分が熱かった。
dialogues.en: We kissed gently.
dialogues.text: We kissed gently.

dialogues.jp: 波紋が広がるように。
dialogues.en:
I haven't felt the soft lips and slender shoulders and her
warms for a while.
dialogues.text:
I haven't felt the soft lips and slender shoulders and her
warms for a while.

dialogues.jp:
そこから全身へと、音夢のぬくもりが伝わって
いく。
dialogues.en: Then I realized I wasn't supposed to touch her......
dialogues.text: Then I realized I wasn't supposed to touch her......

dialogues.jp: 頭の芯がぼうっとする。
dialogues.en:
It was really important, but it felt like a war in a foreign
country which you can only watch on the news in TV.
dialogues.text:
It was really important, but it felt like a war in a foreign
country which you can only watch on the news in TV.

dialogues.jp: 何も考えられない。
dialogues.en: "Mm...... That is it."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... That is it."

dialogues.jp: 何も考えたくない。
このまま──。
dialogues.en: And we saw a cherry blossom fell on us.
dialogues.text: And we saw a cherry blossom fell on us.

dialogues.jp: 伸ばしている手を握りしめて。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 強く引き寄せて。
dialogues.en: "Where did that come from?"
dialogues.text: "Where did that come from?"

dialogues.jp: 思いっきり抱きしめてしまいたかった。
dialogues.en: We looked at each other and looked at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: We looked at each other and looked at the ceiling.

dialogues.jp:
壊れたってかまわない。これぐらいのことで壊
れてしまうのなら、全然かまわない。
dialogues.en: Of course there isn't a cherry tree growing on the ceiling.
dialogues.text: Of course there isn't a cherry tree growing on the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 強い──。
dialogues.en: "You know. I think this come out from our lips."
dialogues.text: "You know. I think this come out from our lips."

dialogues.jp: とても強い誘惑だった。
dialogues.en: She clapped her hand and smiled.
dialogues.text: She clapped her hand and smiled.

dialogues.jp: だけど──。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: （駄目なんだ。……それだけは駄目なんだ）
dialogues.en: "I think it came out from where we kissed."
dialogues.text: "I think it came out from where we kissed."

dialogues.jp:
本当に音夢を失ってしまうわけにはいかないか
ら。
dialogues.en: "It's not a Japanese sweet, you know?"
dialogues.text: "It's not a Japanese sweet, you know?"

dialogues.jp:
ここで誘惑に負けて、感情に流されてしまって、
いいわけなんてなかったから。
dialogues.en:
And then, I realized being able to create Japanese sweets is
more absurd than what she said.
dialogues.text:
And then, I realized being able to create Japanese sweets is
more absurd than what she said.

dialogues.jp:
でも……それでも、理性で歯止めがきく感情じゃ
なかったから。
dialogues.en:
"Japanese sweets? Isn't this so romantic? Our kisses can
create a cherry blossoms."
dialogues.text:
"Japanese sweets? Isn't this so romantic? Our kisses can
create a cherry blossoms."

dialogues.jp: せめてこれぐらいは──。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, yeah......"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, yeah......"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の手にそっと触れ、握る。
dialogues.en: "Oh, you have to go, you'll be late."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you have to go, you'll be late."

dialogues.en: "Don't push my forehead!"
dialogues.text: "Don't push my forehead!"

dialogues.jp: 「……行って来る」
dialogues.en: "I'm paying you back."
dialogues.text: "I'm paying you back."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……行ってらっしゃい兄さん」
dialogues.en: Nemu's pale finger touched my lip.
dialogues.text: Nemu's pale finger touched my lip.

dialogues.jp: ああ……。
dialogues.en: "I'll see you later, niisan."
dialogues.text: "I'll see you later, niisan."

dialogues.jp: まったくもって、嫌になるくらい──。
dialogues.en:
We both embraced, happy to be close together and said
goodbye.
dialogues.text:
We both embraced, happy to be close together and said
goodbye.

dialogues.jp: 俺は音夢が好きなんだ。
dialogues.en: I really, truly ----
dialogues.text: I really, truly ----

dialogues.jp:
音夢の手を離して、逃げていく体温に、俺はそ
う確信した。
dialogues.en: love Nemu a lot.
dialogues.text: love Nemu a lot.

dialogues.jp: ◆いってらっしゃい◆
dialogues.en: ◆See you later◆
dialogues.text: ◆See you later◆

dialogues.jp:
ついに迎えてしまった入学式の日。体調の崩れ
た音夢を察して俺も休もうとしたのだが、どう
しても行って欲しいとせがまれる。
dialogues.en:
It was finally the first day of school. I thought about
skipping school to be with Nemu who still wasn't feeling
well, but she said she wants me to go.
dialogues.text:
It was finally the first day of school. I thought about
skipping school to be with Nemu who still wasn't feeling
well, but she said she wants me to go.

dialogues.jp:
兄さんに思い出を作ってきて欲しいと――自分
の代わりにと。
dialogues.en:
She wants me to have good memories of school for her since
she can't have them.
dialogues.text:
She wants me to have good memories of school for her since
she can't have them.

dialogues.jp: さすがの俺も、仕方なく家を出ることにした。
dialogues.en: So I decided to go because she said so.
dialogues.text: So I decided to go because she said so.
